 Summary
 Four games at 14:00 GMT
 Evanilson gives Bournemouth early lead at Ipswich ; Davis own goal makes it 2-0
 Gomez stunner puts Brighton in front against Brentford ; Thiago sent off before Gross doubles lead from spot
 Le Fee penalty puts Sunderland ahead against Chelsea 
 Mac Allister gives Liverpool lead after Palace hit bar and have goal ruled out; Wirtz doubles lead
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Gary Rose & Sam Drury
 Most recent Most popular SUBSTITUTION published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-2 Liverpool 
 Pierre Sage looks to his bench to try and get Palace back into this one.
 Dario Osorio replaces Quinten Timber.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Ipswich 0-2 Bournemouth 
 Ipswich make a change as Daizen Maeda is replaced by Abdul Fatawu with 25 minutes to go.
 16 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 15:22 GMT 15:22 GMT 
 Brighton 2-0 Brentford 
 Another double change for Brentford. Mathias Jensen and El Hadji Malick Diouf come on for Keane Lewis-Potter and Mamadou Sangare.
 Soon afterwards, Lewis Dunk goes into the book for a trip on Kevin Schade.
 22 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-2 Liverpool 
 Big opportunity for Crystal Palace to create something as Tyrick Mitchell is found in acres down the left.
 However, his low cross is too close to Alisson. A waste for Palace.
 94 47 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Sunderland have to manage Brobbey published at 15:20 GMT 15:20 GMT 
 Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea 
 Gary Bennett 
Ex-Sunderland defender on BBC Radio Newcastle 
 Brobbey’s put a shift in and that’s a worry because I imagine after an hour, he’ll have to come off. That is a worry that Sunderland have. The one thing you don’t him to do is to pick up a strain or an injury. 
 69 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 15:20 GMT 15:20 GMT 
 Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea 
 Pedro Neto picks up an unnecessary yellow card as he looks aghast at being penalised for a foul. Eventually the referee grows tired of Neto's complaints and books him. That still doesn't stop him complaining.
 103 61 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 15:20 GMT 15:20 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-2 Liverpool 
 A flowing Liverpool move now as they threaten a third.
 Alexander Isak starts it with a clever flick into the path of Cody Gakpo, who drives forward before slipping in Bradley Barcola.
 The Frenchman looks to cross when perhaps he should shoot and it's deflected behind.
 From the resulting corner, Barcola has to get back quickly to stop a counter and the referee adjudges that that's a foul and a yellow card.
 31 96 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:19 GMT 15:19 GMT 
 Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea 
 This is only the second time Sunderland are leading in a Premier Leauge game this season and it was the first time they had the lead at half time.
 They are pretty comfortable holding onto their lead against Chelsea so far in this half.
 124 101 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 Ipswich 0-2 Bournemouth 
 Big chance for Bournemouth to add a third as the ball is flicked across the face of goal to James Hill, but he cushions his header over.
 39 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Simple play from Liverpool' published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-2 Liverpool 
 Mark Schwarzer 
Former Chelsea goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It's just one ball down the right from Bradley Barcola, he puts it across goal and Florian Wirtz makes a run at the far post and sends it in.
 Its simple play from Liverpool and poor defending from Crystal Palace. 
 287 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:18 GMT 15:18 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-2 Liverpool 
 We've got a delay as Jeremy Jacquet takes a blow to the head. He seems to be OK but he'll have to head off 60 seconds.
 It's not looking good for Pierre Sage.
 71 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Liverpool should see it through now published at 15:17 GMT 15:17 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-2 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Selhurst Park 
 Florian Wirtz heads over to that Liverpool away end and celebrates his first Premier League goal of the season, That will feel good for the German and for Andoni Iraola. Liverpool should see it through from here.
 464 85 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:15 GMT 15:15 GMT 
 Ipswich 0-2 Bournemouth 
 Ipswich have everyone back as Bournemouth hunt a third. The hosts are struggling to get beyond the halfway line.
 76 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Crystal Palace 0-2 Liverpool published at 15:15 GMT 15:15 GMT 
 Florian Wirtz (54 mins) 
 Lovely Liverpool counter-attack!
 It's starts scruffily but Ronald Araujo and Bradley Barcola sort it out eventually and the latter is send racing away down the left.
 He puts a good ball across the box and Florian Wirtz calmly strokes it home at the far post. Nice finish for his first league goal of the season.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 2002 392 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:14 GMT 15:14 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Liverpool 
 What you have to say about Crystal Palace is that they don't look like a team that has given up on the manager. Pierre Sage's side are giving it everything.
 148 61 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Moises Caicedo: the centre-back published at 15:13 GMT 15:13 GMT 
 Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea 
 Nizaar Kinsella 
BBC Sport senior football reporter at the Stadium of Light 
 Moises Caicedo is playing at centre-back after Levi Colwill came off for winger Estevao Willian at half-time. 
 Colwill was booked and gave away a penalty but that remains an interesting decision. 
 81 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'A lazy pass' published at 15:12 GMT 15:12 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Liverpool 
 Mark Schwarzer 
Former Chelsea goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 I just wonder whether Adam Wharton knows if he's offside and it's just a lazy pass. 
 I feel like he knows and he plays a half hearted ball across goal to Jorgen Strand Larsen.
 49 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:11 GMT 15:11 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Liverpool 
 Crystal Palace have begun this second half strongly and Liverpool need to be careful. Too many sloppy errors are giving the home side all the encouragement they need to try and get back into this one.
 Adam Wharton did break through on goal but then overhit his pass to Jorgen Strand Larsen, who would have had an open goal. The offside belatedly goes up to spare his blushes.
 90 102 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 15:11 GMT 15:11 GMT 
 Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea 
 Chelsea made a change for the second half with defender Levi Colwill replaced by forward Estêvão.
 115 24 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:10 GMT 15:10 GMT 
 Brighton 2-0 Brentford 
 Early chance for Brighton in this second half as Maxim De Cuyper meets a cross at the near post but can't divert his volley on target.
